conv.tip.maic_crop: Safely crops page margins with the maic algorithm before KCC. The result is shown directly in preview; ambiguous edges are preserved.
conv.tip.maic_watermarks: Find trained watermarks around the page perimeter. Matches on a uniform background are removed safely; matches over artwork remain untouched but do not keep an otherwise empty margin from being cropped. A training button appears in the preview toolbar.
conv.tip.maic_page_numbers: Preview and conversion use local digit recognition with saved user corrections.
conv.tip.mobi_padding_states:
○ Padding — Pad the page out to the shared 1400×1920 canvas using Page background. The width clears the widest pages the store ships, so the art is never reduced to reach it and every page of a volume comes out one size.
● No padding — Keep the page proportions and add no margin pixels.
Either way the reader paints the rest of the screen with Page background.
The cover and split-spread halves are never padded.
conv.tip.kfx_padding_states:
○ Padding — Pad the page out to the shared 1400×1920 canvas and bake those pixels into the image using Page background. The width clears the widest pages the store ships, so the art is never reduced to reach it and every page of a volume comes out one size.
● No padding — Keep the page proportions and add no margin pixels.
KFX leaves the rest of the screen white either way: the format has no background colour property, confirmed on device. Padding is the only way to put a dark page's own colour beside its art.
The cover and split-spread halves are never padded.
conv.tip.manga_upscale:
○ Off — ordinary resize to the render height.
◑ Fast — MangaJaNai 2x, selected for the source height; restores linework and cleans the paper.
● Exact — Manga Ora 2x only; enable Scan cleanup separately when JPEG restoration is needed.
Both modes run only on pages below the render height.
conv.tip.manga_upscale_off: Only for the "KFX maic", "KFX + MOBI maic", "MOBI maic" and "EPUB maic" formats.
conv.tip.scan_cleanup: Removes JPEG artifacts at the source resolution after crop and before upscale and resize. The source JPEG quantization table selects the model automatically: HQPlus for quality 81–95, HQ for 61–80, MQ for 26–60, and LQ for 25 and below. Quality 60 selects MQ. Non-JPEG and quality above 95 stay unchanged. Colour pages keep their colour.
conv.tip.scan_cleanup_off: Only for the "KFX maic", "KFX + MOBI maic", "MOBI maic" and "EPUB maic" formats.
conv.tip.stretch_upscale_kfx: Does not apply to "KFX maic", "KFX + MOBI maic", "MOBI maic" or "EPUB maic": every page is built at a fixed height above the screen and the device reduces it, so there is nothing left to stretch or upscale.
conv.tip.facing_pages:
Put two portrait pages in one section, so a landscape screen shows a spread instead of centring one page.
Pairing follows the source's own bisected spreads: the pages running into one are laid out the way the paper paired them. Everything else pairs as it falls, a chapter opening included; bisected spreads and landscape pages are left alone.
conv.tip.facing_pages_off: Only for the "KFX maic", "KFX + MOBI maic", "MOBI maic" and "EPUB maic" formats.
conv.missing.kcc_sub: Only the native formats are offered. Unzip KCC into /modules for the rest.
conv.missing.previewer_sub: Required for the KCC-built MOBI and KFX output, not for “MOBI maic” or “EPUB maic”
conv.missing.kfxlib_sub: Bundled modules/kfxlib is missing. Restore it from the maic source archive to enable KFX output.
conv.tip.facing_pages_epub:
Tell the reader which two portrait pages face each other, so a landscape screen shows a spread instead of centring one page.
Pairing follows the source's own bisected spreads: the pages running into one are laid out the way the paper paired them. Everything else pairs as it falls, a chapter opening included; bisected spreads and landscape pages are left alone.
Off leaves the pairing to the reader.
conv.tip.force_spread_preview:
○ Off — leave every split unchanged.
◑ Auto — inspect ink and continuity at the fold, and match one pixel only when Kindle is unlikely to offer Preview Double Page Spread on its own.
● Always — match one pixel on every split spread.
Only source spreads that maic bisects are considered; ordinary facing pages and source files stay unchanged. EPUB reaches Kindle through Send-to-Kindle as KFX.
conv.tip.force_spread_preview_off: Only for the "KFX maic", "KFX + MOBI maic" and "EPUB maic" formats. Disabled and off for standalone MOBI.
